behavior: For any path already known to belong to one of the fixture tree's two managed roots (the single-module project or the multi-module reactor), calling resolveWorkspace with that path returns the same workspace id regardless of what path under the other root was resolved immediately before it in the same process -- the result is never the id that was last returned for a different root.
rationale: INV-ROUTE-1 names the defect class -- a sticky, cached or default instance -- observable only across a sequence of calls, so it needs an invariant property over command sequences, the stateful shape's mandatory technique; interleaving a call under root A between two calls under root B falsifies an implementation caching the last-resolved workspace and reusing it under a different root -- exactly what spike B's silent-[] misroute finding makes dangerous if it leaks past this layer.
